label: RCC Residential (villa / apartment)
description: The editable core. The generator reads this file + a project's shape (floors, units, common areas) and expands it into site_tasks. Edit this file to change what gets generated. Cardinality is the only structural concept: once = one site-wide task; per_floor = repeated for each floor; per_unit = repeated for each floor x unit; common = shared circulation, emitted when the project has common areas. Each trade carries a `note` — the one-line grounding the LLM reads to write the task description and QC points. Keep the notes; they are what make the output reflect real practice.

cardinalities.once: Emitted once for the whole project (site-wide work and shared services).
cardinalities.per_unit: Emitted once per floor x unit (per-flat build-out and finishes). Villa = 1 unit, so once per floor.
cardinalities.common: Emitted once for shared circulation/areas, only when the project has common areas (apartments, not villas).

trades.label: Ground Leveling
trades.note: Clear and level the plot to a working datum before setting out.

trades.label: Site Marking / Setting Out
trades.note: Set out the building grid from drawings — column centres and axes. Errors here cascade through the entire build.

trades.label: Excavation
trades.note: Dig to founding depth per soil report; keep sides safe and dewater if the water table is high (common on coastal AP sites).

trades.label: PCC (Levelling Course)
trades.note: Plain cement concrete blinding below footings — a clean, level base for the reinforcement.

trades.label: Footings
trades.note: Footing under each column: PCC bed, reinforcement cage, shutter, pour, cure before the plinth beam. (Edit this trade for combined/raft/pile jobs.)

trades.label: Plinth Beam
trades.note: Ties columns at plinth level and carries the blockwork above. Level is critical — every floor stacks true off this.

trades.label: Backfill & Compaction
trades.note: Fill and compact around the foundation in layers before the plinth slab.

trades.label: Plinth Slab
trades.note: Ground-floor base poured after backfill compaction; sets the finished ground level.

trades.label: Columns
trades.note: This floor's vertical members: reinforcement, shutter, plumb-check, pour. Plumb is non-negotiable — out-of-plumb compounds upward.

trades.label: Beams & Shuttering
trades.note: Beam formwork and props for this floor's slab level, set true to line and level.

trades.label: Slab Reinforcement
trades.note: Deck this floor's slab. Reinforcement laid; conduits for the floor ABOVE are cast in now, before the pour.

trades.label: Slab Pour
trades.note: The stage-gate event. Shuttering, reinforcement and cast-in conduits all checked before concrete. Cure 7–14 days before loading.

trades.label: Blockwork
trades.note: Partition and external walls for this unit: line, level, plumb; lintels over openings.

trades.label: Door Frames
trades.note: Frames set during/before plaster — NOT the shutters (those hang late in finishes). A door is not 'done' here.

trades.label: Window Frames
trades.note: Window frames/sub-frames fixed before plaster so plaster closes neatly to them.

trades.label: Electrical Conduiting
trades.note: Wall and ceiling conduiting with back-boxes before plaster, positioned per the electrical layout.

trades.label: Plumbing Chases & Sleeves
trades.note: In-wall water and drainage chases and sleeves for this unit before plaster.

trades.label: Internal Plastering
trades.note: Internal cement plaster AFTER conduiting and frames, BEFORE putty. Two-coat, cured.

trades.label: False Ceiling
trades.note: Gypsum/POP grid where specified. Skip on jobs without false ceilings.

trades.label: Wiring
trades.note: Pull wires through the conduit after plaster; fixtures come later.

trades.label: Wall Putty
trades.note: Wall finishing over plaster before paint. Only where a painted finish is in scope.

trades.label: Floor Preparation
trades.note: Level/screed the base for tiling. Wet-area waterproofing is a SEPARATE finishes task, not here.

trades.label: Vertical Plumbing Risers
trades.note: Main vertical stacks run once all frames are up — they pass through every floor, so they wait for frame completion.

trades.label: Floor Plumbing Rough-ins
trades.note: In-floor lines per wet area. Positions can shift — confirm against the fixture layout before tiling seals them in.

trades.label: Wet-area Waterproofing
trades.note: Bathrooms and balconies before tiling. Ponding test BEFORE covering — a leak found later means breaking tile.

trades.label: Tiling
trades.note: Floor and wall tiling after plumbing rough-ins and waterproofing. Once tiled, the in-floor lines are sealed in.

trades.label: Door Installation
trades.note: Hang the shutters now (frames went in at build-out). After painting prep, to avoid damage.

trades.label: Window Grills
trades.note: Protection/safety grills fixed to the window openings.

trades.label: Painting
trades.note: Final interior coats after putty. Façade painting is the separate envelope track.

trades.label: Staircase Finishing
trades.note: Shared staircase: railing, treads, finishing. Circulation used during construction, so finished late.

trades.label: Lobby & Corridors
trades.note: Shared lobby and corridor flooring, plaster, paint — apartment common circulation, not per-unit.

trades.label: Lift Installation
trades.note: Lift fitted and commissioned in the shaft. Only where a lift is in scope.

trades.label: Façade Treatment
trades.note: Runs PARALLEL to interior finishes (separate crew/track); it does not block interior work.

trades.label: Terrace Waterproofing
trades.note: After the roof slab has cured. Ponding test. Critical — a terrace leak ruins everything below it.

trades.label: Terrace Finishing
trades.note: Protective screed / tiles / china-mosaic over the terrace waterproofing.

trades.label: External Painting
trades.note: Exterior coats — weather-dependent; sequence around the monsoon on coastal AP sites.

trades.label: Cellar / Parking Flooring
trades.note: Stilt/parking/cellar floor — often last, to avoid construction-traffic damage.

trades.label: Fixtures
trades.note: CP fittings, sanitaryware, electrical fixtures, switches, fans. Near the very end to avoid damage and theft.

trades.label: Decorative Installations
trades.note: Final decorative elements, feature cladding, landscaping touches.

trades.label: Snagging & Handover
trades.note: Defect walk, touch-ups, deep clean, handover. The done-of-done.
